summary: Navigation URL validation now parses URLs before policy checks, returning `invalid_url` for malformed inputs and `insecure_url` only for non-http/https schemes unless `allow_insecure` is set. Added coverage for invalid URLs and documented the change in notes, plus updated task status.
notes: Changes are in `src/verify/rules.rs`, `notes/2026-02-11-valid-005-navigate-policy.md`, `notes/index.md`, and `prd.json`. Validation now uses `reqwest::Url` parsing to separate parsing errors from policy errors.
